description:
This week, President Donald Trump promised retribution after the US military said it intercepted a “surprise attack” by Iran on its forces, ending days of relative calm in the Middle East. Later, Saudi Arabian forces joined strikes against the Iran-allied Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF) in Iraq.

And a fire that broke out on two vessels, included one US-owned, at an Egyptian port Wednesday was caused by a drone, authorities said. If confirmed as a deliberate strike, it would mark the first time Egypt has been directly drawn into the regional conflict.

Retired military experts speak to CNN on this week’s developments from the Iran war.

author: CNN
description: Israeli strikes on Gaza left a huge crater at a hospital less than 48 hours after US President Donald Trump announced Hamas and Israel had agreed to advance a ceasefire plan, local authorities said. The attack destroyed vital medical supplies, demolished two medical warehouses at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital and damaged two others, according to Gaza's health ministry. CNN's Abeer Salman reports.
title: Israeli strike leaves crater at Gaza hospital, destroys medical supplies
